raw_segments.text: Thus Satan, talking to his nearest mate, with head uplift above the wave, and eyes that
His other parts besides prone on the flood, extended long and large, lay floating many
a-rude, in bulk as huge as whom the fables name of monstrous size, Titanian or earthborn,
that warred on Jove, Briaryos or Typhon, whom the den by ancient Tarsus held, or that sea-beast
Leviathan, which God of all his works created hugest that swim th, ocean stream.
